description: Järnvägsarealer i hektar efter region. År 2010 - 2020 is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Statistikmyndigheten SCB - Statistiska centralbyrån. Railway area, in hectares by region, observations and year. Coverage: Statistikmyndigheten SCB - Statistiska centralbyrån. The portal shows the English title as "Railway area, in hectares by region. Year 2010 - 2020" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Statistikmyndigheten SCB - Statistiska centralbyrån. Its keywords include Miljö, Land use, Land use in Sweden, Markanvändningen i Sverige (MaiS), Markanvändning, Environment. The listing shows 2 download or service links in JSON. The listing shows 2022-09-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
